title: Known-object test, TOI-6208.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-6208.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, not recovered, recovered (21 covered epochs). Residual screen: 28 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 4 light curve(s), forming 15 distinct event(s), 0 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.
